scope: Retrospective nested cross-validation with compound-level folds.
gene_axis: All supplied one-to-one orthologs; identical full human gene axis in all folds and methods; no target-variance gene selection.
kernel: Descriptor NaNs use training-column medians (all-missing training columns use zero); descriptors/context then training z-scores. Kmol=.5 Tanimoto(PubChem881)+.5 RBF(descriptors); Kctx=RBF(context); RBF=exp(-squared distance/(2*dimension)). Kprior=(Kmol+Kctx+Kmol*Kctx)/3, with a fixed molecule-context interaction. Kprior and count-normalized train-z-scored rat linear Ks are separately training-centered and divided by training mean diagonal. Chemical-only prior uses Kprior; source+same-prior=.5 Kprior+.5 Ks. All weights/bandwidth rules fixed before outer evaluation.
calibrated_source: Training human gene mean + one global beta times (source delta - training source gene mean); beta minimizes training gene-space MSE.
primary: Compound-macro full-gene delta-response MSE; delta=chemical_context MSE minus source_plus_chemical_context MSE.
secondary: Per-condition full response Pearson and training-human-mean residual Pearson; undefined constant-vector correlations remain missing.
inner_selection: Each model has the same alpha grid, outer-training labels, target axis, and group folds; minimum pooled inner compound-macro MSE. No outer-label selection.
training_objective: Row-weighted ridge MSE; evaluation weights compounds equally.
wrong_source: Auxiliary nominal-stratum source mismatch: permute within outer-test time/nominal-dose strata. Absolute planned concentrations can differ between donor and query; this is not a pure identity comparison at identical full exposure context. Desired query context remains fixed. Main paired model comparison uses the identical full exposure context in both arms.
data_warnings: Condition-level replicate means do not retain single-cell distributions or replicate variance (Zenodo 20204514).
RMA jointly normalizes all available arrays within each species before splitting (source 41a_rma_brainarray.R).
The diagnostic_test subset supports retrospective evaluation on published outcomes.
Before absolute-concentration filtering: Dose units are missing for retained conditions; equal dose labels or numeric values do not establish concentration matching.
Before absolute-concentration filtering: Nominal concentration comparison is unknown for 100 retained conditions; unsupported units are not concentration matched.
Absolute-concentration retained cohort has zero unknown/ambiguous units; both arms receive planned nominal molar concentrations.
interval_scope: Compound resampling of fixed OOF predictions. Overlapping fold training creates dependence; no refitting, donor uncertainty, or reliable population coverage guarantee.
limitations: One animal species and one broad liver in-vitro system; species selection is not evaluated.

PubChem fingerprints/physchem form the specified molecular prior; no target annotation or pretrained chemical model is included. Verified complete-compound cohort differs from the full cohort and must be compared within cohort.
Joint RMA normalization and condition-level replicate means define the source data.

Both planned source and human molar concentrations are supplied to both arms; known different concentrations are retained. The incremental input is a measured rat transcriptome. Nominal concentrations do not establish equal intracellular exposure.

molecular_features.join: Case-fold, underscores to spaces, whitespace collapse; no chemical alias inference.
molecular_features.selection_basis: Verified reagent identity and feature availability only; no response values.

absolute_concentrations.rule: Both planned treatment doses must be finite and positive with uniquely resolved attributes/metadata units among M,mM,uM,μM,nM. Case-sensitive fixed conversion to M followed by log10; no inferred units, mass-to-molar conversion, aliases, or rounding.
absolute_concentrations.information_available_to_both_arms: Time, planned rat concentration, planned human concentration, nominal dose indicators and molecular features. Source-plus-prior alone additionally receives measured rat expression response.
absolute_concentrations.interpretation: Nominal administered molar concentrations; intracellular exposure equivalence is not established. Different verified source/target concentrations are retained.

primary_gain_from_source.inference_scope: Compound resampling of fixed OOF predictions. Overlapping fold training creates dependence; no refitting, donor uncertainty, or reliable population coverage guarantee.

matched_vs_wrong_source_gain.inference_scope: Compound resampling of fixed OOF predictions. Overlapping fold training creates dependence; no refitting, donor uncertainty, or reliable population coverage guarantee.
